one_line: Global memory shortages, energy demands, and workforce shifts highlight AI infrastructure pressures as international trade and security rules tighten.

themes.title: Infrastructure strain and hardware investments expand
themes.text: A global memory chip shortage has driven up prices tenfold, while power generator JERA discusses data center builds with Anthropic and Meta near Tokyo. Meanwhile, Texas resumed data center permitting and approved a SpaceX gas power plant, and Avicena raised over $100 million for microLED optical interconnects.

stories.headline: Memory chip shortages spark global procurement war rooms and 10x price hikes
Japan's JERA enters talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres
Avicena raises $100M+ Series C for microLED optical interconnects
Texas resumes data center permitting and approves SpaceX gas plant

themes.title: Corporate restructuring and workforce shifts continue
themes.text: SAP plans to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to shift its software business toward artificial intelligence. Separately, a JP Morgan Wealth Management report estimates that AI could displace around 24 million knowledge-worker jobs globally over five years.

stories.headline: SAP prepares plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions for AI shift
AI could displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs in five years: JP Morgan

themes.title: Export controls and policy tensions grow
themes.text: The Netherlands aims to block the US MATCH Act restricting ASML sales in China, as ASML's CEO warns aggressive export controls will push China toward domestic tech development. Additionally, Z.ai missed its GLM-5.5 launch due to US computing restrictions and anti-distillation measures.

stories.headline: Netherlands seeks to block US MATCH Act restricting ASML China sales
ASML CEO warns aggressive export controls will push China to build domestic tech
Z.ai misses GLM-5.5 launch as US rules and distillation curbs hit China AI

themes.title: New models and agent governance emerge
themes.text: BharatGen launched Patram 1.5 and Chariot AI unveiled the Chariot-1 model suite under the IndiaAI Mission. Google mandated Model Context Protocol servers for Workspace AI agents by February 2027, and Dante Security raised $10 million to monitor enterprise AI agents.

stories.headline: BharatGen launches Patram 1.5, a 7B vision-language model for documents
Chariot AI unveils Chariot-1 LLM and speech models under IndiaAI Mission
Google mandates MCP server access for Workspace AI agents by February 2027
Dante Security raises $10M seed to monitor enterprise AI agents
